festivals: Saroi Khangba - traditional Meitei ritual for the prosperity of the land and to ward off evil, performed in the Meitei lunar month of Lamta (February-March); observed at Khurai Ahongpung and other sacred sites under the supervision of the Lainingthou Sanamahi Temple Board, with priests, priestesses (amaibis) and pena loishangs (per Poknapham, March 2026)

history.dynasty: Ancient Meitei religious tradition; the titular king of Manipur, Leishemba Sanajaoba, described it as the ritual place of the Meiteis 'since time immemorial' when urging the state government to preserve it (May 2018, per e-pao/manipur.org)
history.period: Ancient/prehistoric (no documented founding date); recorded as Manipur state protected monument S-MN-13 ('Khurai Ahongpund'), Imphal East
history.summary: NOT A HINDU TEMPLE - keep-or-drop decision needed. Khurai Ahongpung is a sacred ritual ground of Sanamahism, the indigenous Meitei religion - it is a Sanamahi site, not a Hindu temple. CSV corrections: the actual town is Khurai in Imphal East district, Manipur (NH-202, Khuman Lampak area, ~12 miles from Thoubal per Meta place data) - NOT Thoubal as the CSV states. The traditional Saroi Khangba ritual, performed in the month of Lamta of the Meetei lunar calendar for the prosperity of the land, is observed here under the supervision of the Lainingthou Sanamahi Temple Board; priests invoke Lainingthou Sanamahi and Ima Leimarel Sidabi and offer prayers through traditional rituals to various deities and spirits known as Saroi Ngaroi (per Poknapham, March 2026). In May 2018 the titular king of Manipur drew the state government's attention to the preservation of this ritual place of the Meiteis (per IT News/manipur.org). It is listed as state protected monument S-MN-13 ('Khurai Ahongpund') of Imphal East. In 2017 the Maoist Communist Party named the Khurai Ahongpung site in agitations over indigenous sacred sites kept under 'domination by non-locals'. Identity certainty: high - Meta place data, Poknapham news, and the state monument list all agree on the Khurai/Imphal location.

name: Khurai Ahongpung Temple
town_description: Khurai is a locality of Imphal city in Imphal East district, Manipur, lying on NH-202 near Khuman Lampak (geocoded to Ahong Pung, Thangjam Leikai-Khural Ahongal, Kairang Meitei, Imphal 795005). It is a residential locality of the state capital with no connection to Thoubal town, which is a separate district town about 20 km to the south.
